messages:
dara: Pushed a tiny polish PR for the evals scorecard legend and keyboard-only approval flow. Can folks glance for copy + keyboard access? Need to freeze before next release. kevin: link: https://figma.com/file/scorecard-legend-polish (WIP) mia: looked. Legend: we currently use icons + color for delta meaning. Suggest adding short text nodes in the legend (e.g., '▲ score up', '▼ score down') so color isn't the only signal. oliver: Keyboard flow: when tabbing into a row the first tabbable element should be the expand chevron, then comment dot, then action checkbox. Right now checkbox comes first and it breaks the sequential review flow. dara: good call. I'd prefer chevron -> comment -> checkbox -> actions. That maps to read-then-act. tess: microcopy: dialog that confirms bulk approve currently says "Confirm Approve". Can we make it explicit: "Approve X runs — this will create an audit entry". More transparent for reviewers. mia: also add an explicit reason input (optional) in bulk-approve modal for teams that track context. aria-label it "Approval reason (optional)". kevin: aria: the modal should trap focus and the primary CTA should be keyboard reachable as first focusable element OR ensure skip link to primary CTA. Also close button must be reachable and have aria-label="Close approve dialog". od: aria-bot: Tip: for keyboard-first users, provide a 'Next unreviewed' shortcut only within the suite view, documented in the keyboard help (opt-in). oliver: bulk-undo behavior question: if a user approves 3 separate batches quickly, should a single Undo revert the last batch only? I think last-batch only. Also the toast should show scope: "Undo approve (3 runs)". dara: agree, LIFO per user action. Also persist the audit entry but mark as reverted if undone. tess: small UX: when a row's details are expanded via keyboard, announce via aria-live: "Expanded . Score delta -0.07" so SR users hear the important info. mia: code snippet for the toast aria: ```html
Approved 3 runs.
``` kevin: copy standardization: change top-level header from 'Regressions' to "Changes (Regressions flagged)". Keeps neutral tone but surfaces regressions. dara: thanks — action list: 1) add text labels to legend icons; 2) reorder tabbable elements to chevron->comment->checkbox->action; 3) make bulk-confirm dialog explicit copy + optional reason field + focus trap; 4) LIFO undo scoped to last batch with clear toast copy; 5) aria-live announcements on expand; 6) header -> "Changes (Regressions flagged)". I'll update figma/spec and ping when done. :thumbsup:
